findings.summary: JS falsy-zero: replaceMacros(val || '') converts AUCTION_PRICE=0 to empty string, corrupting macro-replaced URLs
findings.failure_scenario: Server returns a bid response with price=0 (a zero-dollar fill). In replaceAllMacrosInPlace, the macros object has AUCTION_PRICE: 0. When replaceMacros substitutes ${AUCTION_PRICE} in nurl/lurl/adm, the expression 'val || ""' evaluates 0 as falsy, replacing the macro with empty string instead of "0". The resulting win notification URL becomes e.g. "https://adserver.example.com/win?price=" (trailing equals, no value) instead of "https://adserver.example.com/win?price=0", silently dropping the price parameter. This also applies to any other macro whose value evaluates to zero.
